question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column

There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) In the present day (i) both the players and cricket is the spectators alike. (b) It is also the most (ii) all over the world. (c) This game is played (iii) full of thrill and between two excitement. (d) Its popularity is (iv) interesting and enjoyable increasing day by day game in Bangladesh. (e) The game gives (v) discipline and promptness. pleasure to (vi) must population game all over the world. (vii) teams consisting of 22 players.
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (vi) In the present day, cricket is the most popular game all over the world. (b) + (iv) It is also the most interesting and enjoyable game in Bangladesh. (c) + (vii) This game is played between two teams consisting of 22 players. (d) + (ii) Its popularity is increasing day by day all over the world. (e) + (i) The game gives pleasure to both the players and spectators alike.
